text:
nate (eng-platform): quick heads-up — I'm seeing a regression hitting customers on the v2 migration path. Calls that used to hit /v1/embed with nested tool payloads are returning 500s when routed to our v2 front door. Can owners triage? repro below.

ana (eng-runtime): thanks — can you paste the request + minimal stack trace? suspecting header mismatch or a new validation layer on the v2 side. :eyes:

nate (eng-platform): minimal repro:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embed 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input":"render chart","tools":[{"type":"widget","spec":{"width":200}}]}'
```
response: 500 {\"error\":\"internal\",\"message\":\"panic: unknown tool spec\"} — full stack:
```
panic: unknown tool spec
  at runtime/validate.go:112
  at api/handlers/embed.go:58
```

kyle (eng-infra): deploy-bot shows the v2 gateway was rolled yesterday 03:12 UTC (rolling proxy change). Could be a JSON schema validation we turned on. I can repro locally if you point to a test token.

nate (eng-platform): test token: tst_prod_migration. I can share logs in #incidents if needed.

ana (eng-runtime): grabbing it now. initial hunch: runtime validation for tool specs stricter in v2; older SDKs sent a flattened spec that we accepted on v1 but v2 expects namespaced keys. That's why nested tool payloads blow up.

lee (eng-ml): that fits — model serving doesn't touch tool spec but the runtime validation short-circuits earlier. Does this affect function-calling surfaces too?

nate (eng-platform): potentially yes. Customer report was from an app using embed + function/tool combo.

sarah (eng): proposed mitigation: add a compatibility shim in the gateway that translates the legacy flattened spec -> new namespaced shape for the next 72h while we push fixes upstream. Short term: shim is lowest-risk. Longer term: SDKs should be updated and we should add a migration guide.

maria (devex): noted — I'll draft an SDK patch and a short migration note for docs. Which SDKs need patching first? JS + Python.

ana (eng-runtime): owners and immediate action items:
- ana: runtime change (validation relax) + tests
- kyle: gateway shim PR + canary config
- sarah: plan for rollback fallback policy + runbook update
- maria: SDK PRs and migration doc

nate (eng-platform): assigning. can we get a quick canary plan? want minimal customer impact and telemetry to catch regressions.

kyle (eng-infra): I'll open a shim PR now: #4231. Canary: 5% -> 25% over 30m if error rate stays <0.5%, then 50% for 1h, then full. Will add a metric alert: embed_v2_500_rate.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by kyle for sha=9f2a3b (gateway/shim) — canary target: service=gateway, tag=shim-compat, initial=5%.

ana (eng-runtime): for runtime I can push a test that relaxes validation and adds a compatibility flag behind feature-flag fc/legacy-tool-spec. PR #5132. I'll coordinate smoke tests against kyle's canary.

maria (devex): I'll open SDK PRs after we confirm shim. For JS: patch to send the namespaced tool spec when detect older client usage (simple transform). PR draft: github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/118.

sarah (eng): runbook additions: how to toggle shim off, how to route customers to dedicated legacy lanes (if needed). I'll add steps and own the roll-forward decision.

nate (eng-platform): timeline check — can we aim to have shim canary up in 2 hours, SDK PRs drafted EOD, migration doc + changelog entry EOD?

kyle (eng-infra): yes for canary in ~1.5h. I'll post canary start + metrics snapshot.

ana (eng-runtime): runtime PR linked to kyle's shim, test matrix added. I will run regression suite once shim is at 5%.

maria (devex): SDK PRs drafted and will include a clear deprecation note: "legacy flattened tool spec will be removed after 2026-05-01" (tentative).

sarah (eng): pinging legal for the deprecation window wording, but provisional date ok.

nate (eng-platform): thanks all. final ask: please @mention me on the PRs and drop any stderr traces in this thread if you see unusual errors. I'll coordinate customer comms. :thumbsup:

kyle (eng-infra): starting canary now — posting metrics in 10m.

deploy-bot: canary started for service=gateway, tag=shim-compat, percent=5% at 1719236000

ana (eng-runtime): shim looks good at 5% canary, no 500 spikes in the embed_v2_500_rate. progressing to 25%.

nate (eng-platform): seeing reduced error reports from initial customer. thanks.

sarah (eng): keeping runbook open. if error rate crosses 0.5% we rollback to previous gateway.

maria (devex): SDK PR drafts: JS #118, Python #77. Linking tests and migration snippets.

nate (eng-platform): awesome. I'll close this thread once PRs are merged and canary reaches 100% (or we decide on a different root fix).

kyle (eng-infra): canary reached 100% at 1719237680, metrics look clean. closing shim.

deploy-bot: canary completed for service=gateway at 1719237680 (status: success)

nate (eng-platform): resolving — follow-ups: (1) runtime PR to land a proper validation fix without compatibility flag (ana) (2) SDK patches to be released this week (maria) (3) migration guide + changelog (maria + me). Adding to weekly migration board. Thanks everyone. :tada:
